API Security Best Practices for 2025

APIs are the backbone of modern applications, making them prime targets for attacks. Here's how to keep them secure.

Authentication and Authorization

Implement OAuth 2.0 and JWT tokens properly. Use refresh tokens and keep access tokens short-lived.

Rate Limiting and Throttling

Protect your API from abuse and DDoS attacks with intelligent rate limiting.

Input Validation

Never trust client input. Validate everything server-side.
